articles.summary: Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) today (Mon, 27 July) announced that they have extended their longstanding collaboration for a further 5 years. Through this renewed agreement, Ryanair will continue to leverage AWS’s cloud computing and AI technologies, including Amazon Quick, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, across its business, from powering Europe’s largest airline website and optimising schedules across its fleet of 647 aircraft and 3,900 daily flights, to enhancing operational […]
articles.title: RYANAIR AND AWS EXTEND AGREEMENT FOR ANOTHER 5 YEARS

articles.summary: Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (29 Jul) announced that it has carried over 7m passengers through Belfast International Airport since it began operations to/from the airport a decade ago. This summer, Ryanair is operating 166 weekly flights across 15 routes to/from Belfast International Airport, including popular sun hotspots like Alicante, Lanzarote and Malta, as well as top city break destinations like Krakow, Milan and Porto. To celebrate this significant milestone, Ryanair has launched a limited-time […]
articles.title: RYANAIR MARKS 7 MILLION PASSENGERS THROUGH BELFAST INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT

articles.summary: Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (16 Jul) launched a record schedule for Winter 2026, with 1,700 routes across 35 countries, including over 140 new routes. Ryanair’s record Winter 2026 schedule offers customers even more choice for their Winter 2026 getaways, including top winter sun destinations, ski trips, Christmas markets, or city escapes, at the lowest fares in Europe. Ryanair’s full Winter 2026 schedule is available to book now via the Ryanair App / website.
articles.title: RYANAIR LAUNCHES RECORD WINTER 2026 SCHEDULE WITH 80M SEATS ACROSS EUROPE

articles.summary: HIGH COURT REJECTS EDREAMS’ ATTEMPT TO AVOID IRISH COURTS Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (22 Jul) welcomed a High Court ruling rejecting Edreams’ challenge to the Irish courts’ jurisdiction, which now allows Ryanair’s case, to stop Edreams screenscraping Ryanair.com and overcharging customers, to proceed. articles.title: RYANAIR WINS IRISH HIGH COURT RULING AGAINST EDREAMS
